item.text: {"asks":[{"quote":"Do you want Strata to normalize these, for example always showing \"Explore: search for tests\" style labels, or should it show what the provider sent?","question":"Should Strata normalize subagent labels or display the provider-supplied labels?"},{"quote":"Tell me which you'd rather see and I'll do that one.","question":"Should finished activity remain under the message or move into the Trace drawer?"},{"quote":"Is eight the right number, or would you rather it show everything and scroll?","question":"Should the activity strip show eight visible rows or all rows with scrolling?"},{"quote":"Is that enough, or do you want the error inline?","question":"Should subagent errors remain only in the trace or also appear inline in the activity strip?"},{"quote":"Let me know if you'd rather I hold this until the link-opening change lands, since both touch the Conversation panel and there's a small merge risk in the message component.","question":"Should work on the subagent activity strip wait until the link-opening change lands?"}]}
